analysis.title: Safe and accurate focusing technique
analysis.description: A vertical 3-step process slide explaining microscope focusing safety and accuracy, featuring three stacked rectangular panels for Set-up, Safety Check, and Focusing, each with an illustrative line drawing on the left and instructions on the right.
analysis.layout: The title sits at the top-left over a light grid background. Below it are three vertically stacked rectangular cards representing sequential steps: Set-up (top), Safety Check (middle, framed with a highlighted warning box), and Focusing (bottom). Each card pairs a left-side diagram with right-side explanatory text.

components.visibleText:
Set-up
Start with the lowest power objective lens and turn the coarse focus dial to move the stage as close to the lens as possible.

Safety Check
Always look from the side of the microscope when moving the stage upwards.
Never move the stage upwards while looking through the eyepiece—the lens can crush the slide and damage the equipment.

Focusing
Look through the eyepiece and turn the coarse focus dial to move the stage downwards until the image appears. Then, use the fine focus dial to sharpen the resolution.
